data.action: 举起装着金鱼的小袋开怀大笑，另一手仍拿着纸网。
data.description: 夏祭摊位，她挽起袖子全神贯注捞金鱼，浴衣袖摆滑下也顾不上；捞到之后高高举起战利品，虎牙都笑出来的瞬间，比舞台笑容更真实。
data.promptProse: Kana concentrates on scooping a goldfish at the summer festival stall, yukata sleeves rolled back but slipping as she works. After succeeding, she raises her prize with a grin showing a small canine tooth. Her properly wrapped red-and-white floral yukata and dark obi stay clear in medium view. Lantern light warms her face and the water basin, with rippling reflections moving beneath her hands against the darker stall interior.
data.title: 有马加奈 · 祭典捞金鱼的胜负欲
